---
name: Request a pack
about: Ask a product vendor to publish a skill pack for IBM Bob
title: "Request pack: <product>"
labels: pack-request
---

**Product and vendor**
Which product is the pack about, and who owns it (GitHub organisation, team)?

**What the pack should contain**
Skills, MCP servers, rules, commands or modes. Link existing skills if they are already public.

**Why**
The workflow this speeds up, and who on your side would use it.

**Contact at the vendor** (if known)

---
Only the product's vendor publishes packs. The marketplace team forwards this request to the vendor; see `docs/vendor-onboarding.md`.
